scope: Proposition 5.5 (The leading Ihara bracket) of the manuscript “The Deligne-Drinfeld conjecture” (preprints/The-Deligne-Drinfeld-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 008 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5ae63f326803a634), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let ψ ∈ FrLn and ϕ ∈ FsLn′ , where n, n′ > 2 and r, s ≥ 1. Write f, g for their leading projections at counts r, s. Their Ihara bracket, computed in the ambient Lie algebra in x, y, belongs to Fr+s in the A, C, B presentation, and the projection of its component of count r + s is [f, g]. (5.11) This assertion does not require prior closure of the full solution space under the Ihara bracket.
